note: Meridian Atlas 3.10 event additions authored for the global and chronological balance pass. Each entry follows the shipped events.json schema, uses only sources already recorded in this repository or in the reviewed handoff research file, and states its date limits in editorialNotes.

title.zh: 殷墟：晚商都城与甲骨档案
title.en: Yin Xu: the late Shang capital and its oracle-bone archive

summary.zh: 约公元前1300年起，商王把都邑设在洹河两岸的殷墟，宫殿宗庙区、王陵区与手工业作坊沿河分布。这里出土的甲骨卜辞记录祭祀、战争、农事与王令，是重建商代晚期政治与文字的第一手材料。前1046年商亡后都邑废弃，遗址在二十世纪的系统发掘中重新进入历史叙述。
summary.en: From about 1300 BCE the Shang kings ruled from Yin Xu on the Huan River, where palace-temple compounds, royal tombs and craft workshops were laid out along the banks. Oracle-bone inscriptions found there record sacrifice, warfare, harvests and royal commands, making the site a primary source for late Shang politics and writing. The capital was abandoned after the Shang fell in 1046 BCE.

significance.zh: 甲骨与都城遗存共同支撑了商代晚期历史的重建。
significance.en: Oracle bones and urban remains together underpin the reconstruction of late Shang history.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Yin Xu

editorialNotes.zh: 年代采用世界遗产条目所记约前1300—前1046；甲骨占卜不记录全部政务，不能当作完整的王室档案。
editorialNotes.en: The 1300–1046 BCE range follows the World Heritage listing. Divination bones do not record all government business and are not a complete royal archive.

title.zh: 丝绸之路廊道上的跨洲交换
title.en: Transcontinental exchange along the Silk Roads corridor

summary.zh: 公元前二世纪以后，连接长安与中亚绿洲的交通线持续扩展，商队、使者与僧侣沿塔里木盆地南北两道往来。丝绸、马匹、玻璃、香料与纸张在绿洲城市间转手，佛教、摩尼教与伊斯兰教也随商路传播。十四世纪前后海上贸易与政治变动改变了陆路格局，但廊道上的城市与知识网络并未立即消失。
summary.en: After the second century BCE the routes linking Chang'an with Central Asian oases expanded, carrying caravans, envoys and monks along the northern and southern edges of the Tarim basin. Silk, horses, glass, aromatics and paper changed hands in oasis cities, while Buddhism, Manichaeism and Islam spread along the same roads. Maritime trade and political change later reshaped these networks without ending them at once.

significance.zh: 这条廊道说明欧亚大陆的贸易、宗教与知识交流长期依赖同一套绿洲城市网络。
significance.en: The corridor shows how trade, religion and knowledge in Eurasia depended on one network of oasis cities.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Silk Roads: the Routes Network of Chang'an–Tianshan Corridor

editorialNotes.zh: 本条描述廊道网络的长期运行，不主张某条路线的精确走向，也不把商路视为由单一政权全程管理。
editorialNotes.en: This entry describes the long-running network rather than an exact route alignment, and does not treat the routes as administered by a single power throughout.

title.zh: 佛教沿丝绸之路的传播
title.en: Buddhism travels along the Silk Roads

summary.zh: 公元前后的数百年间，佛教从印度经中亚绿洲传入塔里木盆地与中国内地，僧侣、商队与使团沿同一路线往返。译经活动把梵文与中亚语言文本转写为汉文，寺院在绿洲城市和交通节点建立，犍陀罗与敦煌等地形成融合多种艺术传统的造像与壁画。八世纪以后陆路佛教社群在部分地区衰落，但网络遗产延续至今。
summary.en: In the centuries around the beginning of the common era, Buddhism travelled from India through Central Asian oases into the Tarim basin and China, carried by monks, merchants and envoys. Translation projects rendered Sanskrit and Central Asian texts into Chinese, monasteries grew at oasis towns, and Gandhara and Dunhuang developed hybrid sculptural and mural traditions.

significance.zh: 佛教的陆路传播说明宗教、贸易与翻译网络在欧亚大陆相互交织。
significance.en: The overland spread of Buddhism shows how religious, commercial and translation networks intertwined across Eurasia.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Buddhism along the Silk Road

editorialNotes.zh: 传播并非单向或均质，各地接受的时间与形式差异很大，本条只用世纪尺度表述。
editorialNotes.en: Transmission was neither one-way nor uniform; the entry therefore uses century-scale phrasing.

title.zh: 阿努拉德普勒：佛教圣城的兴衰
title.en: Anuradhapura: rise and fall of a Buddhist sacred city

summary.zh: 约公元前3世纪起，阿努拉德普勒成为僧伽罗王国的都城与上座部佛教中心。佛塔、寺院与供水系统在城市周围扩展，僧团与王权互相支持，来自南亚与东南亚的朝圣者和商人往来其间。十世纪末，南印度朱罗军队攻占并破坏城市，政治中心随后东移，但寺院与朝圣传统延续下来。
summary.en: From about the third century BCE Anuradhapura served as the capital of Sinhalese kings and a centre of Theravada Buddhism. Stupas, monasteries and waterworks spread around the city as monastic institutions and royal power supported one another, while pilgrims and traders arrived from South and Southeast Asia. At the end of the tenth century a Chola army sacked the city and the political centre moved east.

significance.zh: 阿努拉德普勒体现了王权、僧团与水利社会在南亚的长期结合。
significance.en: Anuradhapura embodies the long alliance of royal power, monastic institutions and irrigation society in South Asia.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Sacred City of Anuradhapura

editorialNotes.zh: 前3世纪为圣城传统的起点；993年是政治中心转移的事件年份，不代表佛教传统的终结。
editorialNotes.en: The third century BCE marks the beginning of the sacred-city tradition; 993 is a political event year, not the end of Buddhist practice.

title.zh: 多拉维拉：印度河城市的水利与规划
title.en: Dholavira: water management and planning in an Indus city

summary.zh: 约公元前3000年至前1500年，多拉维拉在卡奇荒漠的岛上发展出分区明确的城市：城堡、中城与下城由城墙和通道分隔，石砌蓄水池、水井与引水沟把季风降水保存下来。居民制作印章、珠饰与陶器，并依靠畜牧、种植和远距离交换维持生计。区域水系变化与贸易重组后，城市逐渐衰落。
summary.en: Between about 3000 and 1500 BCE, Dholavira grew on an island in the Rann of Kutch as a planned city whose citadel, middle and lower towns were separated by walls and passages. Stone reservoirs, wells and channels stored monsoon water, while seals, beads and pottery linked the city to wider exchange. Changing water systems and trade contributed to its later decline.

significance.zh: 多拉维拉以水利设施展示了印度河文明对干旱环境的适应能力。
significance.en: Dholavira's waterworks show how an Indus civilisation city adapted to a semi-arid environment.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Dholavira: a Harappan City

editorialNotes.zh: 约前3000—前1500是占居期概括，城内各阶段的兴衰并不同步，也未把某座蓄水池的年代扩展为全城年代。
editorialNotes.en: The 3000–1500 BCE range summarises the occupation period; phases within the city were not synchronous, and no single reservoir date is extended to the whole site.

title.zh: 罗马斗兽场落成与公共娱乐
title.en: Inauguration of the Colosseum and Roman public entertainment

summary.zh: 公元80年，提图斯为罗马斗兽场举行落成活动。这座由弗拉维王朝修建的圆形竞技场可容纳数万观众，用于角斗、狩猎表演与公开处决。竞技活动与皇帝、元老和民众之间的政治关系相连，也依赖帝国各地提供的物资与人力。斗兽场在后世被反复使用和拆解，其外壳仍是最具辨识度的罗马建筑之一。
summary.en: In 80 CE Titus inaugurated the Colosseum, the Flavian amphitheatre built for tens of thousands of spectators, where gladiatorial contests, hunts and executions took place. The shows were bound up with political relations among emperor, senate and people and depended on supplies and manpower drawn from across the empire. Later reuse and stone robbing left the arena's shell.

significance.zh: 斗兽场把罗马的公共娱乐、皇权展示与帝国资源动员集中在一座建筑之中。
significance.en: The Colosseum concentrated Roman public entertainment, imperial display and resource mobilisation in one building.

sources.title: Parco archeologico del Colosseo — Blood and the Arena

editorialNotes.zh: 80年为落成活动之年，建筑在弗拉维王朝期间分期完成；后世使用与拆解持续到中世纪以后。
editorialNotes.en: 80 CE is the inauguration year; the building was completed in stages under the Flavians, and later reuse and stone removal continued for centuries.

title.zh: 大明宫与唐长安宫城
title.en: The Daming Palace and the palace city of Tang Chang'an

summary.zh: 634年，唐朝廷在长安城东北的龙首原营建大明宫，此后成为皇帝听政与居住的主要宫城。宫城沿南北中轴排列含元殿、宣政殿与紫宸殿，朝会、政务与内廷活动分区展开。大明宫与郭城、里坊和东西市共同构成唐长安的都城秩序，其宫室布局也影响了东亚其他都城的建设。
summary.en: In 634 the Tang court began building the Daming Palace on high ground northeast of Chang'an, and it became the main palace where emperors held audience and governed. Halls arranged along a north–south axis separated ceremonial, administrative and residential functions. Together with the outer city, wards and markets, the palace expressed the spatial order of the Tang capital.

significance.zh: 大明宫体现了唐代宫城制度与都城规划的结合。
significance.en: The Daming Palace exemplifies how Tang palace institutions and capital planning were combined.

sources.title: Xi'an Municipal Government — Ancient city celebrates new national 5A-level scenic spot

editorialNotes.zh: 634年为始建之年，此后多次增修；本条不把某一殿的落成年份当作整座宫城的完成时间。
editorialNotes.en: 634 is the year construction began; halls were added later, so no single hall date is treated as completion of the whole palace city.

title.zh: 跨撒哈拉黄金贸易网络
title.en: The trans-Saharan gold trade network

summary.zh: 八至十四世纪，西非的黄金经撒哈拉商路运往马格里布与地中海，换取食盐、铜、纺织品和马匹。商队以绿洲城镇为节点，加纳、马里等政权通过控制贸易与征税积累财富，伊斯兰商人、学者与工匠随之往来。黄金流通把西非、北非与欧洲市场连接起来，也塑造了萨赫勒城市的文化面貌。
summary.en: Between the eighth and fourteenth centuries West African gold travelled the Saharan routes to the Maghrib and the Mediterranean in exchange for salt, copper, textiles and horses. Caravan towns served as nodes, while polities such as Ghana and Mali taxed and protected commerce. Muslim merchants, scholars and craftsmen moved along the same routes, linking West Africa with North Africa and Europe.

significance.zh: 跨撒哈拉贸易把西非纳入中世纪世界经济与宗教网络。
significance.en: The trans-Saharan trade connected West Africa with medieval economic and religious networks.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Trans-Saharan Gold Trade (7th–14th Century)

editorialNotes.zh: 七至十四世纪为来源概述范围；黄金产量与流向的具体规模仍有争论，本条不作数量估计。
editorialNotes.en: The seventh-to-fourteenth-century range follows the source overview; output and direction of gold flows remain debated, so no quantities are given.

title.zh: 八世纪巴格达的天文翻译与观测
title.en: Astronomical translation and observation in eighth-century Baghdad

summary.zh: 八世纪中叶起，阿拔斯宫廷与学者把印度、波斯和希腊的天文与数学著作译成阿拉伯文，并在巴格达组织观测与编制历表。印度天文著作的传入带来正弦计算与历法方法，学者在此基础上发展出新的计算与记录传统。这些成果后来经伊比利亚和西西里传入欧洲，成为中世纪共享的天文学知识。
summary.en: From the mid-eighth century, Abbasid patrons and scholars translated Indian, Persian and Greek astronomical and mathematical works into Arabic and organised observations and tables in Baghdad. Indian astronomy brought sine computation and calendrical methods, on which scholars built new computational and observational traditions. This knowledge later reached Europe through Iberia and Sicily.

significance.zh: 巴格达的翻译与观测工作把不同文明的天文传统汇入同一套知识体系。
significance.en: Translation and observation in Baghdad merged astronomical traditions from several civilisations into one body of knowledge.

sources.title: UNESCO Silk Roads Programme — Evolution of Astronomy along the Silk Roads

editorialNotes.zh: 具体翻译者、著作与年代在研究中仍有争论，本条只用世纪尺度表述，不指定某一次翻译的年份。
editorialNotes.en: Translators, works and dates remain debated, so the entry uses century-scale phrasing rather than assigning a year to a single translation.

title.zh: 平安京的营建与都市格局
title.en: Foundation and urban layout of Heian-kyō

summary.zh: 794年，日本朝廷把都城迁到山城国盆地中的平安京。都城参照大陆都城制度规划，以南北中轴大道和棋盘式街区组织宫城、官署与市集。盆地西部的低湿地与东侧河流影响街区扩展方向，贵族宅邸、寺院与市场逐渐成形，为延续千年的京都城市生活奠定格局。
summary.en: In 794 the Japanese court moved the capital to Heian-kyō, laid out in the Yamashiro basin on a grid of streets around a north–south axis, following continental models of capital planning. Wetlands to the west and rivers to the east shaped the direction of growth, while aristocratic residences, temples and markets gradually took shape around the planned core.

significance.zh: 平安京的规划奠定了京都长期作为政治与文化中心的空间基础。
significance.en: The planning of Heian-kyō gave Kyoto its long-lasting spatial framework as a political and cultural centre.

sources.title: Agency for Cultural Affairs, Japan — Historic Monuments of Ancient Kyoto: Identification, History

editorialNotes.zh: 794年为迁都之年；都城的实际范围与人口在此后数十年逐步扩展，不能把规划图等同于同期建成区。
editorialNotes.en: 794 is the year of the move; the built-up area and population expanded over subsequent decades, so the planned grid is not equated with the contemporary built city.

title.zh: 萨迈拉：阿拔斯王朝的新都
title.en: Samarra: a new Abbasid capital

summary.zh: 836年，阿拔斯哈里发穆塔西姆把宫廷与军队迁往底格里斯河畔的萨迈拉，以安置突厥军人并避开巴格达的紧张局势。新城沿河延伸数十公里，包含宫殿、军营、清真寺与赛马场，螺旋宣礼塔成为标志。892年宫廷返回巴格达后，萨迈拉逐渐失去政治功能，城市遗迹仍保存了当时的空间组织。
summary.en: In 836 the Abbasid caliph al-Mu'tasim moved his court and army to Samarra on the Tigris, accommodating Turkish troops and distancing himself from tensions in Baghdad. The new city stretched for tens of kilometres along the river, with palaces, barracks, mosques and a racecourse, its spiral minaret a landmark. After the court returned to Baghdad in 892, Samarra lost its political role.

significance.zh: 萨迈拉展示了阿拔斯帝国如何用新建都城安置军队与宫廷。
significance.en: Samarra shows how the Abbasid empire used a newly built capital to house its army and court.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Art of the Abbasid Period (750–1258)
UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Samarra Archaeological City

editorialNotes.zh: 836—892为宫廷驻萨迈拉的时期，城市在此后仍有居民，不能把宫廷迁出视为城市废弃。
editorialNotes.en: 836–892 is the period of the court's residence; the city remained inhabited afterwards, so the court's departure is not treated as abandonment.

title.zh: 后古典期玛雅城邦与抄本传统
title.en: Postclassic Maya polities and the codex tradition

summary.zh: 古典期结束后的数百年间，尤卡坦与高地地区的玛雅政治体重新组合，奇琴伊察、玛雅潘等中心先后兴起。各城邦通过联盟、战争与贸易往来，沿海盐场与内陆市场连接起来。以树皮纸抄本和彩绘陶器为载体的历法与创世叙事继续流传，十六世纪的焚毁与散佚之后仅存少量抄本。
summary.en: In the centuries after the Classic period, Maya polities in Yucatán and the highlands regrouped, with centres such as Chichen Itza and Mayapan rising in turn. Alliances, warfare and trade linked coastal salt works with inland markets. Calendrical and creation narratives continued to circulate in bark-paper codices and on painted ceramics; only a few codices survived the sixteenth century.

significance.zh: 后古典期玛雅表明古典期之后仍有持续的政治重组与文化创造。
significance.en: The Postclassic Maya show continued political reorganisation and cultural production after the Classic period.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Creation Narratives on Ancient Maya Codex-Style Ceramics (Metropolitan Museum Journal 51)

editorialNotes.zh: 900—1500为概括时段，各中心的兴起与衰落在年代上并不一致；抄本证据主要来自陶器图像与少量残本。
editorialNotes.en: The 900–1500 range is a general period; centres rose and declined at different times, and codex evidence comes mainly from ceramic imagery and a few surviving manuscripts.

title.zh: 泉州：宋元时期的海洋贸易枢纽
title.en: Quanzhou: a maritime trading hub of the Song and Yuan

summary.zh: 十至十四世纪，泉州凭借港湾、桥梁与腹地手工业成为印度洋与西太平洋贸易网络的重要节点。陶瓷、丝绸与香料在此转运，来自阿拉伯、波斯与东南亚的商人聚居城南，清真寺、佛寺与天后宫并存。元末战乱与港口条件变化之后，泉州的国际贸易地位逐渐让位于其他口岸。
summary.en: Between the tenth and fourteenth centuries Quanzhou became a major node in Indian Ocean and West Pacific trade, handling ceramics, silk and aromatics through its harbour, bridges and hinterland workshops. Arab, Persian and Southeast Asian merchants settled in the southern quarters, where mosques, Buddhist temples and the Tianhou shrine stood together. War and changing harbour conditions later reduced its international role.

significance.zh: 泉州展示了宋元中国与印度洋世界之间的商品、人群与信仰交流。
significance.en: Quanzhou shows the exchange of goods, people and beliefs between Song–Yuan China and the Indian Ocean world.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Quanzhou: Emporium of the World in Song-Yuan China

editorialNotes.zh: 十至十四世纪为遗产条目概括的繁荣期，不等于城市全部存续时间；刺桐等外来名称只用于相应时段。
editorialNotes.en: The tenth-to-fourteenth-century range is the prosperity period recorded by the listing, not the city's whole lifespan; foreign names such as Zayton apply only to those centuries.

title.zh: 萨拉丁与开罗城堡
title.en: Saladin and the Cairo Citadel

summary.zh: 1176年，阿尤布王朝的萨拉丁下令在穆卡塔姆山修建开罗城堡，以取代易受攻击的旧城防。城堡扼守城市东侧高地，兼具军事指挥、行政与居住功能，此后长期是埃及统治者的权力中心。城堡的修建改变了开罗的城市重心，也留下跨越多个王朝的建筑层。
summary.en: In 1176 Saladin of the Ayyubid dynasty ordered a citadel on the Muqattam ridge to replace Cairo's exposed older defences. Commanding high ground east of the city, it combined military, administrative and residential functions and remained a centre of power for later rulers, shifting the city's centre of gravity and accumulating buildings from several dynasties.

significance.zh: 开罗城堡说明军事防御如何重塑中世纪都城的空间与权力结构。
significance.en: The Cairo Citadel shows how military defence reshaped the space and power structure of a medieval capital.

sources.title: Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities — Cairo Citadel

editorialNotes.zh: 1176年为下令修建之年，工程在此后延续；本条不把城堡某一期的形制套用于全部历史。
editorialNotes.en: 1176 is the year the order was given; construction continued afterwards, and no single building phase is extended across the site's whole history.

title.zh: 阇耶跋摩七世与圣剑寺
title.en: Jayavarman VII and Preah Khan

summary.zh: 十二世纪末，吴哥国王阇耶跋摩七世在战胜占婆之后大规模营建寺院与公共设施。1191年铭文记载的圣剑寺奉献给国王之父，寺院兼具佛教与印度教崇拜、医疗和行政功能，并与周围村落及水利系统相连。这些营建把王权、宗教功德与地方社会更紧密地结合起来。
summary.en: In the late twelfth century the Angkorian king Jayavarman VII, after campaigns against Champa, undertook large-scale temple and public building. Preah Khan, recorded in a 1191 inscription, was dedicated to his father and combined Buddhist and Hindu worship with medical and administrative functions, linked to surrounding villages and waterworks.

significance.zh: 圣剑寺显示吴哥王权如何通过寺院网络组织宗教与社会服务。
significance.en: Preah Khan shows how Angkorian power organised religious and social services through temple networks.

sources.title: APSARA National Authority — Preah Khan: Great Architecture and a Symbol of Victory

editorialNotes.zh: 1191年为铭文所记寺院建设年，营建活动延续到十三世纪初；碑铭所述功能不等同于日常运作的全部细节。
editorialNotes.en: 1191 is the foundation year recorded in the inscription and building continued into the early thirteenth century; epigraphic functions are not the whole of daily practice.

title.zh: 库斯科王国的早期扩张
title.en: The early expansion of the kingdom of Cusco

summary.zh: 约十三世纪初，印加人以库斯科谷地为中心形成小型王国，通过联姻、战争与水利建设逐步控制周边谷地。1438年前后，帕查库特克在位期间击败强敌并重组国家机构，此后扩张速度明显加快。库斯科的城市规划、道路与祭祀体系在这一过程中逐步成形，成为帝国权力的中心。
summary.en: From about the early thirteenth century the Inka formed a small kingdom centred on the Cusco valley, gradually controlling neighbouring valleys through marriage, warfare and waterworks. Around 1438, during the reign of Pachacuti, a major victory and institutional reorganisation preceded much faster expansion. Cusco's planning, roads and ceremonial system took shape as the centre of imperial power.

significance.zh: 库斯科王国阶段解释了印加帝国扩张的制度与空间起点。
significance.en: The Cusco kingdom phase explains the institutional and spatial starting point of Inka imperial expansion.

sources.title: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian — Inka: Creation Stories

editorialNotes.zh: 约1200—1438为早期王国阶段；具体年代依赖口述传统与后世编年，学界存在分歧。
editorialNotes.en: The c. 1200–1438 range covers the early kingdom; exact dates rest on oral tradition and later chronicles and remain debated.

title.zh: 第四次十字军与拉丁帝国
title.en: The Fourth Crusade and the Latin Empire

summary.zh: 1204年，第四次十字军攻陷君士坦丁堡，城中遭到大规模劫掠，拉丁帝国在拜占庭领土上建立。流亡政权在尼西亚、伊庇鲁斯与特拉比松延续拜占庭统治；1261年尼西亚军队收复君士坦丁堡，米海尔八世恢复帝国。这次分裂削弱了拜占庭的财政与军事能力，也改变了东地中海的政治与教会关系。
summary.en: In 1204 the Fourth Crusade captured Constantinople, which was extensively sacked, and a Latin empire was established on Byzantine territory. Exiles maintained Byzantine rule at Nicaea, Epirus and Trebizond; in 1261 Nicaean forces retook Constantinople and Michael VIII restored the empire. The rupture weakened Byzantine finances and military capacity and reshaped eastern Mediterranean politics.

significance.zh: 1204年的分裂改变了拜占庭国家与东地中海秩序。
significance.en: The rupture of 1204 transformed the Byzantine state and the eastern Mediterranean order.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Byzantium (ca. 330–1453)

editorialNotes.zh: 1204—1261为拉丁帝国时期；1261年复国后的疆域与制度已与1204年以前不同。
editorialNotes.en: 1204–1261 is the Latin Empire period; after 1261 the restored empire's territory and institutions differed from those before 1204.

title.zh: 马穆鲁克时期开罗的城市扩张
title.en: Urban expansion of Mamluk Cairo

summary.zh: 1250年至1517年，马穆鲁克苏丹统治埃及与叙利亚，开罗进入持续扩张期。新的街区、供水设施、清真寺、经学院与商队驿站相继修建，宗教与慈善捐赠把教育、商业和城市服务联系起来。开罗连接地中海、红海与撒哈拉商路，成为当时规模最大的伊斯兰城市之一。
summary.en: Between 1250 and 1517 the Mamluk sultans ruled Egypt and Syria, and Cairo expanded continuously. New quarters, water installations, mosques, colleges and caravanserais were built, while charitable endowments linked education, commerce and urban services. Connected to Mediterranean, Red Sea and Saharan routes, Cairo became one of the largest Islamic cities of its time.

significance.zh: 马穆鲁克开罗体现了宗教捐赠制度与城市经济的结合。
significance.en: Mamluk Cairo embodies the link between charitable endowment institutions and the urban economy.

sources.title: Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities — Historical Cairo

editorialNotes.zh: 1250—1517为马穆鲁克统治期；城市扩张在此前已经展开，并在奥斯曼时期继续。
editorialNotes.en: 1250–1517 is the Mamluk period; the city had already expanded earlier and continued to do so under Ottoman rule.

title.zh: 吴哥核心区的十四世纪转型
title.en: Fourteenth-century transformation of Angkor's urban core

summary.zh: 十四世纪，吴哥都城核心区的土地利用强度逐步下降，护城河与沟渠出现淤积和浮生植被，居民向其他区域分散。传统叙述把1431年的军事失败视为城市突然废弃，但沉积与遥感研究表明转变持续数十年，与气候波动、水利失效和政治重心转移交织。吴哥的寺院与部分聚落仍在继续使用。
summary.en: During the fourteenth century land use in Angkor's administrative and economic core declined gradually; moats and channels silted up and floating vegetation spread as settlement dispersed. The military defeat of 1431 has often been read as sudden abandonment, but sedimentary and remote-sensing research indicates a longer transformation linked to climate, failing water management and shifting political centres.

significance.zh: 吴哥的转型说明城市衰落往往是长期过程，而不是单一战役的结果。
significance.en: Angkor's transformation shows that urban decline is often a long process rather than the result of one battle.

sources.title: University of Sydney — New research casts doubt on cause of Angkor's collapse

editorialNotes.zh: 1431年仍是重要的政治事件年份，但研究不支持“全城骤然废弃”的表述；本条也不把转型归因于单一原因。
editorialNotes.en: 1431 remains a significant political date, but the evidence does not support sudden abandonment of the whole city; no single cause is asserted.

title.zh: 维查耶纳伽尔与亨比都城
title.en: Vijayanagara and the capital at Hampi

summary.zh: 十四世纪中叶，维查耶纳伽尔王国以通加巴德拉河畔的亨比为中心统治南印度。都城依托花岗岩丘陵、河流与灌溉系统扩展，寺庙、集市与王室建筑组成密集的城市景观，并与波斯、葡萄牙及东南亚商人保持贸易联系。1565年塔利科塔战役后都城被攻陷并遭劫掠，城市迅速衰败。
summary.en: From the mid-fourteenth century the Vijayanagara kingdom ruled much of South India from Hampi beside the Tungabhadra river. The capital expanded around granite hills, water systems and irrigated land, its temples, bazaars and royal quarters forming a dense urban landscape linked to Persian, Portuguese and Southeast Asian trade. After the battle of Talikota in 1565 the city was sacked and rapidly declined.

significance.zh: 亨比显示了南印度帝国都城如何以宗教与商业空间组织权力。
significance.en: Hampi shows how a South Indian imperial capital organised power through religious and commercial space.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Hampi

editorialNotes.zh: 1336年为传统建国年；1565年为都城被攻陷之年，王国的地方势力此后仍延续一段时间。
editorialNotes.en: 1336 is the traditional foundation year; 1565 is the year the capital fell, after which regional powers of the kingdom persisted for a time.

title.zh: 帖木儿定都撒马尔罕与工匠迁移
title.en: Timur's capital at Samarkand and the movement of craftsmen

summary.zh: 1370年，帖木儿定都撒马尔罕，以此为基地向波斯、中亚与西亚扩张。都城营建集合了从各地征调或迁移来的工匠，蓝色琉璃砖、穹顶与经学院形成此后中亚建筑的基本语汇。撒马尔罕同时是商路枢纽，来自中国、印度、波斯与草原的货物和人群在此交汇，宫廷也扶植波斯书法与细密画。
summary.en: In 1370 Timur made Samarkand his capital and expanded from there into Persia, Central Asia and West Asia. Building projects gathered craftsmen transferred or recruited from conquered regions, and glazed tilework, domes and colleges shaped a lasting Central Asian architectural vocabulary. As a caravan hub the city brought together goods and people from China, India, Persia and the steppe.

significance.zh: 帖木儿的撒马尔罕把军事征服、工匠迁移与跨区域贸易结合为一体。
significance.en: Timur's Samarkand combined military conquest, the movement of craftsmen and transregional trade.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Art of the Timurid Period (ca. 1370–1507)

editorialNotes.zh: 1370年为定都之年；主要建筑的营建延续到十五世纪，不能把这一时期全部归入帖木儿在位年代。
editorialNotes.en: 1370 is the year the capital was established; major building continued into the fifteenth century and is not all assigned to Timur's reign.

title.zh: 阿兹特克三邦同盟的形成
title.en: Formation of the Aztec Triple Alliance

summary.zh: 1428年，特诺奇蒂特兰、特斯科科与特拉科潘的统治者联合击败阿斯卡波察尔科的霸权，组成通常称为阿兹特克的三邦同盟。同盟通过贡赋、军事扩张与联姻控制墨西哥谷地及周边地区，贡赋清单记录布匹、粮食、羽毛与金属制品。三邦各自保留内政，外交与战争则多共同行动。
summary.en: In 1428 the rulers of Tenochtitlan, Texcoco and Tlacopan combined to defeat the hegemony of Azcapotzalco, forming the alliance commonly called the Aztec empire. Through tribute, military expansion and marriage the three cities dominated the Basin of Mexico and beyond; tribute rolls record cloth, food, feathers and metalwork. Each city kept its own internal government.

significance.zh: 三邦同盟的建立是阿兹特克扩张与贡赋体系的起点。
significance.en: The Triple Alliance marks the starting point of Aztec expansion and its tribute system.

sources.title: British Museum — The Aztecs: educational resource

editorialNotes.zh: 1428年为通常采用的结盟年份；三个城市的内政保持独立，“帝国”是后世概括的说法。
editorialNotes.en: 1428 is the conventional date of the alliance; the three cities retained separate internal government, and 'empire' is a later summary term.

title.zh: 十六至十七世纪明代瓷器与全球贸易
title.en: Ming porcelain and global trade in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries

summary.zh: 十六世纪起，景德镇等窑场烧造的青花瓷沿多条海路进入东南亚、西亚、东非与欧洲市场。白银流入与海外需求推动窑场扩大生产，商人与船主把瓷器、丝和香料编入跨洋贸易网络，欧洲与西亚的订制纹样也反馈到中国窑场。明代后期的战乱与海禁变化使部分航线中断，瓷器已成为早期全球贸易的标志商品。
summary.en: From the sixteenth century, blue-and-white porcelain from Jingdezhen and other kilns reached Southeast Asian, West Asian, East African and European markets by several sea routes. Inflowing silver and overseas demand encouraged larger production, while merchants wove porcelain, silk and spices into transoceanic networks. Foreign orders and motifs also reached Chinese kilns.

significance.zh: 瓷器贸易说明明代中国经济已深度参与早期全球商品流动。
significance.en: The porcelain trade shows how deeply the Ming economy was involved in early global commodity flows.

sources.title: Smithsonian Libraries — Ming: porcelain for a globalised trade

editorialNotes.zh: 条目以十六至十七世纪为范围，不把某一年的贸易量当作全程水平；景德镇为代表性产地而非唯一窑口。
editorialNotes.en: The range covers the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries; no single year's volume stands for the whole period, and Jingdezhen is a representative rather than the only production centre.

title.zh: 十六世纪奥斯曼宫廷与帝国文化
title.en: The sixteenth-century Ottoman court and imperial culture

summary.zh: 十六世纪，奥斯曼帝国以伊斯坦布尔为中心整合巴尔干、安纳托利亚、阿拉伯地区与北非。宫廷工坊为苏丹和高级官员制作瓷器、织物、地毯、金属器与细密画，把帖木儿、波斯与地中海传统熔合为可辨识的宫廷风格。行会与市场供应城市日常所需，帝国的视觉语言也随行政与贸易网络传播到各行省。
summary.en: In the sixteenth century the Ottoman empire, centred on Istanbul, governed the Balkans, Anatolia, the Arab lands and North Africa. Court workshops produced ceramics, textiles, carpets, metalwork and miniature painting for the sultan and officials, fusing Timurid, Persian and Mediterranean traditions into a recognisable court style. Guilds and markets supplied daily urban needs.

significance.zh: 奥斯曼宫廷艺术体现了帝国行政、贸易与多元传统的结合。
significance.en: Ottoman court art embodies the combination of imperial administration, trade and diverse traditions.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Art of the Ottomans before 1600

editorialNotes.zh: 来源关注1600年以前的宫廷艺术，本条不据此描述帝国全部制度，也不把宫廷风格等同于各行省的日常器物。
editorialNotes.en: The source concerns court art before 1600; this entry does not describe the empire's whole institutional order or equate court style with provincial everyday objects.

title.zh: 萨法维丝织与宫廷赞助
title.en: Safavid silk textiles and court patronage

summary.zh: 萨法维王朝时期，宫廷工坊与城市作坊生产大量丝织品，用于赏赐、外交与出口。伊斯法罕等地的织工以金线、银线和复杂花纹制作袍服与壁毯，丝绸贸易为王朝提供重要收入，并连接欧洲、奥斯曼与印度市场。十八世纪初的政治动荡与贸易路线变化使生产规模下降。
summary.en: Under the Safavid dynasty, court and urban workshops produced large quantities of silk textiles for gifts, diplomacy and export. Weavers in Isfahan and other cities used gold and silver thread and complex patterns for robes and hangings, and the silk trade provided major revenue while linking European, Ottoman and Indian markets. Political upheaval later reduced output.

significance.zh: 丝织业把萨法维宫廷的消费、外交与跨区域市场连接在一起。
significance.en: Silk production linked Safavid court consumption and diplomacy with transregional markets.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Persian Silks (exhibition)
Encyclopaedia Iranica — Safavid dynasty

editorialNotes.zh: 1500—1722为王朝概括范围，丝织生产的盛期与地区分布并不均衡，本条不作产量估计。
editorialNotes.en: 1500–1722 is the dynasty's overall range; silk production peaked unevenly across regions, and no output figures are given.

title.zh: 马六甲陷落与葡萄牙海上据点
title.en: The fall of Melaka and the Portuguese maritime base

summary.zh: 1511年，葡萄牙舰队攻占马六甲，控制了这个连接印度洋与南海的港口国家。此前马六甲依靠季风航线、税收与多语商人群体成为区域贸易中心；陷落后葡萄牙修筑要塞并试图维持香料与航运垄断，但亚齐、柔佛等政权的竞争使贸易分流。东南亚港口格局由此进入欧洲势力与本地政权并存的新阶段。
summary.en: In 1511 a Portuguese fleet captured Melaka, taking over the port polity that linked the Indian Ocean with the South China Sea. The city had prospered on monsoon shipping, tolls and a multilingual merchant community. Portugal built a fortress and sought to control spices and shipping, but competition from Aceh, Johor and others diverted trade.

significance.zh: 马六甲的陷落改变了东南亚海上势力的分布与贸易路线。
significance.en: The fall of Melaka changed the distribution of maritime power and trade routes in Southeast Asia.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Melaka and George Town, Historic Cities of the Straits of Malacca

editorialNotes.zh: 1511年为攻占之年；葡萄牙对香料与航线的实际控制始终有限，不能表述为垄断整个海域。
editorialNotes.en: 1511 is the year of the conquest; Portuguese control of spices and routes was always partial and is not described as a monopoly of the sea.

title.zh: 阿克巴时期的帝国整合与宫廷文化
title.en: Imperial consolidation and court culture under Akbar

summary.zh: 1556年阿克巴继位后，莫卧儿帝国通过军事征服、联姻与行政改革把北印度和德干部分地区纳入统治。皇帝在法泰赫普尔西克里与拉合尔等地的宫廷中集合波斯、印度与中亚的工匠、画家和学者，推行翻译与宗教辩论。这种整合扩大了帝国的税基，也留下了多语言、多宗教的宫廷文化。
summary.en: After Akbar acceded in 1556, the Mughal empire incorporated much of northern India and parts of the Deccan through conquest, marriage alliances and administrative reform. At courts in Fatehpur Sikri and Lahore he gathered Persian, Indian and Central Asian craftsmen, painters and scholars, encouraging translation and religious debate. This widened the revenue base and produced a multilingual court culture.

significance.zh: 阿克巴时期奠定了莫卧儿帝国行政与文化整合的基本模式。
significance.en: Akbar's reign established the basic pattern of Mughal administrative and cultural consolidation.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Art of the Mughals before 1600

editorialNotes.zh: 1556—1605为阿克巴在位期；艺术史来源侧重宫廷赞助与绘画，不能覆盖帝国全部税制与地方行政。
editorialNotes.en: 1556–1605 is Akbar's reign; the art-historical source emphasises court patronage and painting and does not cover the whole revenue or local administration.

title.zh: 胡马雍陵与莫卧儿纪念建筑
title.en: Humayun's Tomb and Mughal commemorative architecture

summary.zh: 十六世纪六十年代，莫卧儿宫廷在德里为皇帝胡马雍营建陵墓，约1570年完成。陵园采用四分花园、水渠与居中穹顶的布局，由波斯与印度工匠共同建造，成为此后莫卧儿陵墓建筑的重要参照，也影响了泰姬陵一类纪念性建筑的空间组织。陵园在后世经历修缮与再利用。
summary.en: In the 1560s the Mughal court built a tomb for the emperor Humayun in Delhi, completed around 1570. Its charbagh garden, water channels and central dome were made by Persian and Indian craftsmen and became an important reference for later Mughal tombs, shaping the spatial organisation of monuments such as the Taj Mahal.

significance.zh: 胡马雍陵把波斯园林传统转化为莫卧儿纪念建筑的基本范式。
significance.en: Humayun's Tomb turned Persian garden traditions into a basic model for Mughal commemorative architecture.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Humayun's Tomb, Delhi

editorialNotes.zh: 来源以1560年代与约1570年概括建造与完成时间，本条沿用该概括，不指定动工的具体日期。
editorialNotes.en: The source summarises construction in the 1560s and completion around 1570; this entry follows that summary without assigning a precise start date.

title.zh: 阿巴斯一世与伊斯法罕
title.en: Shah Abbas I and Isfahan

summary.zh: 十六世纪九十年代，萨法维沙阿阿巴斯一世把都城从加兹温迁到伊斯法罕，围绕皇家广场营建清真寺、巴扎、宫殿与桥梁，并把新城区设为瓦克夫地产以支持宗教与公共设施。迁都使政治中心远离奥斯曼前线，同时加强了与印度洋和欧洲贸易的联系。伊斯法罕由此成为十七世纪西亚最大的城市之一。
summary.en: In the 1590s Shah Abbas I moved the Safavid capital from Qazvin to Isfahan, laying out mosques, bazaars, palaces and bridges around a royal square and endowing the new centre as waqf property. The move placed the court farther from the Ottoman frontier and strengthened links with Indian Ocean and European trade. Isfahan became one of the largest cities of seventeenth-century West Asia.

significance.zh: 伊斯法罕的营建把萨法维的政治、宗教与商业权力集中于新的都城。
significance.en: The building of Isfahan concentrated Safavid political, religious and commercial power in a new capital.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica — Safavid dynasty

editorialNotes.zh: 迁都时间来源记为十六世纪九十年代；本条不把某一年的工程视为城市全部建成，也不采用缺乏依据的人口数字。
editorialNotes.en: The source places the transfer in the 1590s; no single year's works are treated as completion of the city, and no unsupported population figures are used.

title.zh: 曼加斯与罗伊·马塔的酋长权威
title.en: Mangaas and the chiefly authority of Roi Mata

summary.zh: 十七世纪初，瓦努阿图中部岛屿的酋长罗伊·马塔以曼加斯一带的居所与仪式空间行使权威。当地社会依靠芋田、渔猎与交换维持生计，酋长通过分配资源、主持仪式和联姻维系跨岛关系。罗伊·马塔死后被葬于勒勒帕岛，其头衔与传说延续至今，成为当地社会记忆的一部分。
summary.en: In the early seventeenth century the chief Roi Mata exercised authority from residences and ceremonial places around Mangaas in central Vanuatu. Communities lived from taro gardens, fishing and exchange, while the chief sustained inter-island relations through the distribution of resources, ritual and marriage. After his death he was buried on Lelepa, and his title and stories remain part of local memory.

significance.zh: 罗伊·马塔遗址记录了太平洋岛屿酋长制度与口述传统的结合。
significance.en: The Roi Mata sites record the combination of Pacific chiefly institutions and oral tradition.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Chief Roi Mata's Domain

editorialNotes.zh: 坐标为遗产地整体代表点，不是单独居所址；年代为十七世纪初，来源明确否定十六世纪的说法。
editorialNotes.en: The coordinate is the representative point of the whole property, not the individual residence; the date is the early seventeenth century, and the source explicitly rules out the sixteenth.

title.zh: 廷巴克图手稿传统与十八世纪学术活动
title.en: Timbuktu's manuscript tradition and eighteenth-century scholarship

summary.zh: 十七至十八世纪，廷巴克图的家族图书馆持续抄写与收藏手稿，内容涵盖天文学、法律、算术、医学与商业契约。商队贸易带来的收入支持学者教学与书籍流通，部分天文和法律抄本明确记为十八世纪抄写。这些手稿说明撒哈拉以南非洲存在延续数百年的书写与学术传统。
summary.en: In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries family libraries in Timbuktu continued to copy and collect manuscripts on astronomy, law, arithmetic, medicine and commercial agreements. Income from caravan trade supported teaching and the circulation of books; some astronomical and legal copies are explicitly dated to the eighteenth century.

significance.zh: 廷巴克图手稿表明西非城市拥有延续数百年的书写与学术网络。
significance.en: Timbuktu's manuscripts show that West African cities sustained centuries-long written scholarly networks.

sources.title: Library of Congress — Ancient Manuscripts from the Desert Libraries of Timbuktu
UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Timbuktu

editorialNotes.zh: 1733年抄本只是展品中的例证，不代表全部藏书的年代；家族图书馆的收藏史并不连续完整。
editorialNotes.en: The 1733 copy is one exhibited example, not the date of every manuscript, and the history of family libraries is not continuous or complete.

title.zh: 二条城与幕府在京都的权威
title.en: Nijō Castle and shogunal authority in Kyoto

summary.zh: 1603年，德川家康在京都营建二条城，并在此向朝廷与诸侯显示将军权威。此后二百余年，幕府通过驻京机构、城郭与仪式参与京都的政治生活，二条城既是将军的居所，也是幕府与宫廷交涉的场所。1867年，德川庆喜在此表明奉还大政的意向，幕府统治随之结束。
summary.en: In 1603 Tokugawa Ieyasu built Nijō Castle in Kyoto, using it to display shogunal authority before the court and lords. For more than two centuries the shogunate took part in the capital's political life through residences, fortifications and ceremony. In 1867 the castle hosted the declaration of intent to return governing power to the emperor, ending shogunal rule.

significance.zh: 二条城把幕府权力与京都宫廷的长期共存凝固在建筑与仪式之中。
significance.en: Nijō Castle materialises the long coexistence of shogunal power and the Kyoto court in architecture and ceremony.

sources.title: City of Kyoto / Nijō-jo Castle — Chronology

editorialNotes.zh: 1603年为现二之丸区域完成之年；1867年为表明奉还大政意向之年，政权移交在此后数月完成。
editorialNotes.en: 1603 is the completion year of the present Ninomaru area; 1867 is the year the intent to return power was declared, with the transfer completed in the following months.

title.zh: 沙贾汗纳巴德与红堡营建
title.en: The building of Shahjahanabad and the Red Fort

summary.zh: 1639年，莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汗在德里旧城以北营建新的都城沙贾汗纳巴德，宫殿城堡红堡于1648年前后完成。红堡沿雅穆纳河西岸展开，亭阁、水渠与花园结合波斯、帖木儿和印度建筑传统；宫堡与清真寺、集市共同构成帝国都城。此后德里多次经历政权更替，红堡始终是权力象征。
summary.en: In 1639 the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan began a new capital, Shahjahanabad, north of earlier Delhi, and the palace-fortress known as the Red Fort was completed around 1648. Set beside the Yamuna, its pavilions, water channels and gardens combined Persian, Timurid and Indian traditions, while mosques and bazaars formed the imperial city around it.

significance.zh: 沙贾汗纳巴德集中体现了莫卧儿都城规划与建筑综合能力。
significance.en: Shahjahanabad concentrates Mughal achievement in capital planning and architectural synthesis.

sources.title: Ministry of Culture, Government of India / Press Information Bureau — Red Fort, Delhi: Backgrounder
UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Red Fort Complex

editorialNotes.zh: 1639—1648为红堡建造期；此后红堡经过改建并长期作为军事设施使用。
editorialNotes.en: 1639–1648 is the Red Fort's construction period; it was later altered and long used as a military installation.

title.zh: 清代宫廷绘画与帝国文化整合
title.en: Qing court painting and imperial cultural consolidation

summary.zh: 十七世纪后期至十八世纪，清廷通过画院、南巡与宫廷收藏组织绘画创作，皇帝、满洲贵族、汉族文人与欧洲传教士画家共同参与。宫廷绘画既记录典礼、战功与巡幸，也吸收文人山水和西洋透视技法，成为多民族帝国展示秩序与自我叙述的工具。这些作品同时也限定了后人观看清帝国的视角。
summary.en: From the late seventeenth to the eighteenth century the Qing court organised painting through the academy, imperial tours and collections, bringing together the emperor, Manchu nobles, Han literati and European missionary artists. Court pictures recorded ceremonies, campaigns and journeys while combining literati landscape with Western perspective, serving as instruments of imperial self-presentation.

significance.zh: 宫廷绘画显示清代如何用图像整合多民族帝国的政治秩序。
significance.en: Court painting shows how the Qing used images to integrate the political order of a multi-ethnic empire.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Qing Dynasty (1644–1911): Painting

editorialNotes.zh: 1662—1795覆盖康熙后期至乾隆末年的主要赞助期；绘画赞助集中于宫廷与精英，不能代表清代全部视觉文化。
editorialNotes.en: 1662–1795 covers the main patronage period from the later Kangxi to the end of Qianlong; patronage centred on court and elite circles and does not represent all Qing visual culture.

title.zh: 莱武卡与十九世纪太平洋港镇
title.en: Levuka and the nineteenth-century Pacific port town

summary.zh: 十九世纪二十年代起，斐济的莱武卡因海滩交易、椰油和贸易船而发展成港镇。欧洲商人、传教士与斐济社群在此交汇，木构商铺、仓库、教堂与行政建筑沿滨海形成低层街区。1874年斐济成为英国殖民地后，莱武卡一度作为首府；1882年首府迁往苏瓦，港镇的发展随之放缓。
summary.en: From the 1820s Levuka grew into a port town in Fiji through beachcomber trade, coconut oil and shipping. European traders, missionaries and Fijian communities met there, and low-rise wooden shops, warehouses, churches and administrative buildings lined the shore. After Fiji became a British colony in 1874 Levuka briefly served as capital; the capital moved to Suva in 1882 and growth slowed.

significance.zh: 莱武卡展示了太平洋岛屿港镇在殖民接触时期的空间与社会形态。
significance.en: Levuka shows the spatial and social form of a Pacific island port town during colonial contact.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Levuka Historical Port Town

editorialNotes.zh: 1820年代为港镇发展阶段起点，不能据此推断当地村落形成于此时；1874与1882年的政治变化分别表述。
editorialNotes.en: The 1820s mark the beginning of the port-town phase and do not imply that local villages began then; the political changes of 1874 and 1882 are kept separate.
